data.name: Suraj Yadav
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Suraj Yadav has made a big mark in cricket. With 17 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 51, with an average of 11.73 and a quick strike rate of 134.35. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 15 sixes and 8 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 50.3 overs, taking 35 wickets at an economy rate of 8.85. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
